response.reply: Nee varumbol meeting mudiyumayirunnu, njan alle athu thadanjathu!

response.reply: Neenga romba early-ah vandhu enna periya achievement panniteenga? Konjam ore level-ah irunga boss!
response.english_meaning: Did you achieve something huge by coming super early? Calm down and stay at my level, boss!

response.reply: மீட்டிங்குக்கு லேட்டா வர்றதுக்கு நான் ஒன்னும் உங்கள மாதிரி சும்மா இருக்கறவன் இல்ல, வேலை இருக்கறவன்!
response.english_meaning: I'm not sitting around doing nothing like you, I actually have work to do!

response.reply: Nee timing chusthe, clock kooda shock ayyi slow ga nadusthundi emo! Next time alarm ki kuda ticket koni ivvu.

response.english_meaning: I'm not late to the meeting, you just arrived a bit too early!
